title: CNN-based classifier for subject-independent MBTI Extraversion/Introversion preference classification from short-time EEG signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.28442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines whether short, minimally preprocessed EEG segments contain sufficient information to distinguish between individuals classified as extraverted or introverted according to the Myers--Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). EEG recordings from 50 participants were divided into 4-s segments and analyzed using a subject-independent nested 5-fold cross-validation procedure to compare EEGNet, EEGProgress, and a newly proposed compact convolutional architecture, SSCNet. SSCNet achieved the highest mean accuracy (0.6481), AUC (0.7063), and F1-score (0.6276). The proposed architecture also showed the lowest variability across folds. SSCNet demonstrated the best computational efficiency, with the shortest median training epoch time and the highest training throughput despite having a similar number of trainable parameters to EEGProgress. translated_title: 基于CNN的分类器：利用短时脑电信号进行与被试无关的MBTI外向/内向偏好分类
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨经过最少预处理的短时脑电（EEG）片段是否包含足够的信息，以区分根据迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI）被划分为外向或内向的个体。来自50名参与者的脑电记录被分割为4秒的片段，并采用与被试无关的嵌套5折交叉验证程序进行分析，比较了EEGNet、EEGProgress以及新提出的紧凑卷积架构SSCNet。SSCNet取得了最高的平均准确率（0.6481）、AUC（0.7063）和F1分数（0.6276），并且在各折之间表现出最低的变异性。此外，SSCNet展现出最佳的计算效率，尽管其可训练参数数量与EEGProgress相近，但其单轮训练的中位时间最短、训练吞吐量最高。结果表明，MBTI外向-内向偏好可能可以通过短时脑电信号得到中等程度的预测。
tldr: 本研究提出紧凑型卷积神经网络SSCNet，仅需4秒的短时脑电信号即可实现与被试无关的MBTI外向/内向偏好中等程度预测，在准确率、稳定性和计算效率上均优于EEGNet和EEGProgress等现有方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes SSCNet, a compact CNN architecture that achieves moderate subject-independent prediction of MBTI Extraversion/Introversion preferences from only 4-second minimally preprocessed EEG segments, outperforming EEGNet and EEGProgress in accuracy, stability, and computational efficiency.
